say: Before you make a route, set up each robot in five steps.
caption: Set up each robot before you make a route.

say: Bench Tests checks every mechanism. Calibrate measures the drive.
caption: Bench Tests checks. Calibrate measures.

say: You need the robot, a battery, the controller, an SD card, tape, two people and a laptop.
caption: Robot, battery, controller, SD card, tape, two people, laptop.

say: Step 1. Plug the brain into the laptop. Upload Bench Tests to slot 3, and Calibrate to slot 4.
caption: Bench Tests to slot 3. Calibrate to slot 4.

say: These lines are for robot one. For robot two, type ROBOT equals tank.
caption: Robot two: ROBOT=tank instead of ROBOT=one.

say: If make stops with a list of facts, give the list to whoever types your robot's facts.
caption: make stopped? Pass on its list of facts.

say: Step 2. On the brain, open Bench Tests and do five tiles, in order.
caption: Open Bench Tests (slot 3). Five tiles, in order.

say: Tile 1: every motor, the IMU and the camera should be on the port your form says.
caption: 1 DEVICE CENSUS: every device on its port.

say: Tile 4: pair the controller until it reads connected.
caption: 4 BATT/CTRL: the controller reads CONNECTED.

say: Tile 5: all three SD card steps should pass. If not, reformat the card.
caption: 5 SD CARD PROBE: all three steps pass.

say: Tile 2: turn the whole robot to its left. The big number should rise.
caption: 2 IMU + ROTATE: turn it left; the number rises.

say: Then tile 13. Its red edge means it powers the mechanisms.
caption: 13 MECH POWERS: it powers motors.

say: At station 13, nothing moves unless L1 is held. Hold it the whole time.
caption: Hold L1 the whole time.

say: Up and down jog the mechanism. R1 adds volts: three, six, nine, twelve.
caption: UP / DOWN jog it. R1 adds volts.

say: Touch YES, CLEAR. Then hold L1, press up, and touch YES, POWER IT.
caption: YES, CLEAR, then YES, POWER IT.

say: Press A. It moves a little. Touch which way it went. For the cascade, plus is up.
caption: Press A, then touch which way it moved.

say: Write the verdict on the form: OK, or a word like reversed.
caption: Write down the verdict: OK or REVERSED.

say: The line under the name always tells you what to do now.
caption: Read the line under the name first.

say: To measure the cascade, start on its bottom stop and touch RECORD.
caption: Bottom stop, then RECORD.

say: Hold up to raise it. Let go the moment it stops rising.
caption: Hold UP. Let go when it stops rising.

say: Tape the height at the top, and touch RECORD. Do the same at any level.
caption: Top stop: tape it, then RECORD.

say: Write down the output degrees number. That is the one that gets typed.
caption: Write down the output … deg number.

say: Run each side toggle briefly. The arm that moves shows which port is the right one.
caption: Side toggles: which arm moves?

say: Fire each piston once, then touch where it went.
caption: Pistons: fire once, touch where it went.

say: A jog stops after three seconds. Let go of L1, then hold it again.
caption: Stopped at 3 s? Let go of L1, hold again.

say: Step 3. With the SD card in, put the robot at one end of the tape, front first.
caption: Robot at the tape's end, front along it.

say: Open Calibrate in slot 4. Hands off while the IMU warms up.
caption: 1/4 IMU: hands off.

say: Push it straight along the tape, front leading, the full 48 inches. Then let go.
caption: 2/4 PUSH: front first, the full 48 in.

say: When the green DONE appears, touch it and step back.
caption: Touch DONE, then step back.

say: It twitches one motor at a time. Motors that turn together are one side.
caption: 3/4 PULSES: stand clear.

say: Then it spins both ways to measure the track width.
caption: 4/4 SPIN: stand clear.

say: When it says SAVED, take a photo of the screen.
caption: SAVED: take a photo of the screen.

say: Touch RUN AGAIN and do it once more. Two runs that agree are a measurement.
caption: RUN AGAIN: two runs that agree.

say: If you see FRONT FLIPPED, nothing was saved yet.
caption: FRONT FLIPPED: nothing saved yet.

say: Pushed with the back leading by mistake? Touch RUN AGAIN, and push front first.
caption: Back led by mistake? RUN AGAIN.

say: Touch USE NEW only if the cables were swapped, or you changed the front on purpose.
caption: Cables swapped, or a new front? USE NEW.

say: Step 4. Once your answers are typed in, upload shulib Drive to slot 1 and run it.
caption: Upload shulib Drive to slot 1.

say: Push the stick forward. The robot should drive toward its front, straight.
caption: Stick forward: it drives toward its front.

say: Check that every button does what the driver file says.
caption: Every button does its job.

say: If it drives backwards, run Calibrate again, front first, and touch USE NEW.
caption: Backwards? Calibrate again, then USE NEW.

say: Step 5. Your robot is ready. Open the route builder and make your first route.
caption: Now open the route builder.
